units.title: Engaging with the ancient Roman world through texts

topics.title: Accessing and responding to Latin texts

subtopics.title: Accessing and responding to Latin texts

outcomes.text: access and interpret Latin texts to explore the ancient Roman world
respond to texts and convey information in Latin or English, as appropriate
develop and apply strategies to interpret and translate Latin texts to convey meaning in English
understand and begin to apply the phonological and orthographic systems of Latin
develop knowledge of the vocabulary, structures and features of Latin grammatical systems to understand, translate and respond to texts
compare Latin vocabulary and language structures and features with English, using metalanguage

topics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

subtopics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

outcomes.text: recognise that language, texts and artefacts provide insights into culture and identity

units.title: Engaging with the ancient Roman world through texts

topics.title: Accessing and responding to Latin texts

subtopics.title: Accessing and responding to Latin texts

outcomes.text: interpret Latin texts to analyse the society and culture of the ancient Roman world
respond to texts and discuss ideas about ancient Roman society in Latin or English, as appropriate
apply strategies to interpret and translate Latin texts to convey meaning and demonstrate understanding of context, purpose and audience
apply the phonological and orthographic systems of Latin in a range of contexts
select and use vocabulary, grammatical structures and linguistic features of Latin to interpret, translate and respond to texts
explain how Latin vocabulary, structures and features extend understanding of English, using metalanguage

topics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

subtopics.title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

outcomes.text: reflect on and explain how language, texts and artefacts provide understanding of culture and identity
